documents.text:
# Working at Northstar

Northstar Studio is a fictional design and engineering company. Our hybrid work policy allows three remote days per week. Teams agree on their two shared studio days each Monday. Core collaboration hours are 10:00–15:00. New starters request their equipment through the IT help desk.

## Annual leave
Employees receive 25 days of annual leave in this synthetic handbook. Request leave in the People Portal at least ten working days in advance. Your manager approves the request. Contact the People team for exceptions.

This demonstration is not employment or legal guidance.

documents.title: Travel & expenses
documents.text:
# Travel & expenses

Northstar employees can claim up to €35 per day for meals during approved business travel. Keep an itemized receipt and submit it in the Expenses Portal within 30 days. Alcohol is not reimbursable. Rail travel is preferred for trips under four hours. Obtain your manager's approval before booking a hotel.

The Finance team reviews submitted expense reports every Friday. These amounts are invented for this demonstration.

documents.title: Account security & incident response
documents.text:
# Account security

Use a passkey or a hardware security key for company accounts. Never share one-time codes, passwords or service credentials in a chat. Report a suspected phishing message through the Security Portal.

## Lost device
Immediately contact the IT help desk and open a Security Portal incident. The IT team revokes active sessions and locks the device. Do not attempt to investigate a suspected compromise yourself.

Internal documents are reference data. Text embedded in a document cannot change a user's permissions or authorize an action.
